# FieldPad: HVAC CRM for Solo Techs

> The all-in-one iOS CRM and business management app built for solo HVAC technicians. Clients, scheduling, estimates, invoices with signatures, inventory, equipment history, and recurring jobs — offline-ready on iPhone for $29.99/mo or $299.99/yr. EPA Section 608 and Subpart C compliance included in the box.

## About FieldPad

FieldPad is a mobile CRM and business management app (iOS 17+) built specifically for solo HVAC technicians and one-person refrigeration service shops. It replaces the stack of tools a solo tech normally cobbles together — Jobber or Housecall Pro for CRM, a separate invoicing tool, a separate scheduling app, a compliance tracker, a refrigerant reference — with a single offline-ready iPhone app.

Unlike Jobber (starts at $29/mo for stripped-down CRM), Housecall Pro (starts at $59-$79/mo, capped at 1 user on the Basic tier), Workiz (bundled 2-5 user seats), FieldEdge (requires $500-$2K setup fee + 5-week onboarding), and ServiceTitan ($200-$400 per tech per month, built for 20+ truck shops), FieldPad is priced, designed, and shipped for one-person businesses: no per-seat tax, no forced team features, no internet required.

**Developer**: Huggler Holdings LLC
**Contact**: fieldpad@fieldpadpro.com
**Website**: https://fieldpadpro.com
**App Store**: Available now at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fieldpad-hvac-service-pro/id6758357329 (Android coming soon)

## Core CRM & Business Features

- **Client Management**: Full client records with MapKit-powered address autocomplete, complete service history, jobs, invoices, and equipment linked to each contact.
- **Job & Work Order Management**: Create, schedule, and track service jobs with status workflow (Pending, In Progress, Complete, Canceled). Automatic schedule-conflict detection prevents double-booking.
- **Recurring Jobs**: Schedule weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual repeat service (Pro).
- **Estimates & Quotes**: Professional estimates with line items, split labor/material tax rates, and one-tap conversion to invoices.
- **Professional Invoicing**: PDF invoices with digital signatures (customer and technician), split tax rates, partial payment tracking, custom business logo (Pro), and unique invoice numbering.
- **Inventory Management**: Refrigerant cylinder tracking with OCR label scanning, weight tracking (full, tare, current), exchanges, chain-of-custody, and low-inventory alerts.
- **Equipment & Asset History**: Equipment profiles per client with full service history, full-charge documentation, and all associated jobs and compliance logs.
- **Scheduling & Calendar**: Month/week/day calendar, recurring events (Pro), repair-deadline tracking, and inspection schedules.
- **Offline-First Architecture**: Every feature works in basements, mechanical rooms, and rural service calls with no signal. Data syncs automatically via iCloud when online.
- **Glove Mode**: 48pt minimum touch targets so you don't have to peel off work gloves to tap a button.
- **No Account Required**: No login, no vendor lock-in. Data stays on your device and in your private iCloud container.
- **12 Notification Types**: Job reminders, repair deadlines, verification test follow-ups, low-inventory alerts, chronic-leaker warnings.

## Bonus: EPA Compliance Suite (Included)

Other CRMs (Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Workiz, FieldEdge, mHelpDesk) have zero EPA Section 608 or AIM Act Subpart C support. FieldPad includes the full compliance suite at no extra cost:

- **EPA Section 608 Compliance**: ODS refrigerant service logging for systems with 50+ lbs of charge. Leak-rate thresholds: Commercial 20%, Comfort Cooling 15%, Industrial 30%.
- **AIM Act Subpart C Compliance** (effective January 1, 2026): HFC service logging for systems with 15+ lbs and GWP > 53. Thresholds: Commercial 20%, Comfort Cooling 10%, Industrial 30%, Transport 10%.
- **Leak Rate Calculations**: Automatic Method 1 (Annualized) and Method 2 (Screening) with threshold pass/fail.
- **A2L Safety Checklists**: 6 mandatory safety checks for R-454B, R-32, R-452B (dissipation, spark-free tools, ventilation, PPE, A2L leak detector, grounding).
- **5,000 Rule Calculator**: Repair vs replace decision tool.
- **Chronic Leaker Detection**: Monitors 125% annual threshold with March 1 reporting deadline (Pro export).
- **Automatic Framework Detection**: System picks Section 608 vs Subpart C based on refrigerant GWP.
- **Technician Certification Profiles**: EPA Type I, II, III, Universal with expiration tracking.

## Pricing

- **Free Tier** ($0/forever): 5 clients, 10 jobs, 10 invoices, 5 estimates, 20 compliance logs, 10 cylinders, 15 OCR scans, 8 PDF generations. All core features included. No credit card required.
- **FieldPad Pro**: **$29.99/mo or $299.99/yr** (annual = $24.99/mo equivalent). Unlimited clients, jobs, invoices, estimates, compliance logs, cylinders, OCR scans, and PDF generation. Adds data export (JSON/CSV), compliance log export, recurring jobs, business logo on invoices, and full digital signatures.

## Privacy

- All data stored locally on device (SwiftData/SQLite) and in user's private iCloud container
- No server-side storage — Huggler Holdings LLC does not operate any servers
- No analytics, tracking, or advertising
- Only third-party services: RevenueCat (anonymous subscription management), Apple MapKit (address autocomplete), Apple iCloud (data sync)

## Regulatory Reference (for compliance FAQs)

### Section 608 (ODS Refrigerants)
- Applies to: Systems with 50+ lbs of ODS refrigerant (e.g., R-22)
- Leak thresholds: Commercial 20%, Comfort Cooling 15%, Industrial 30%
- Repair deadline: 30 days (120 days for industrial process)
- Record retention: Minimum 3 years

### Subpart C (HFC Refrigerants, effective Jan 1, 2026)
- Applies to: Systems with 15+ lbs of HFC refrigerant with GWP > 53 (e.g., R-410A, R-454B, R-32)
- Leak thresholds: Commercial 20%, Comfort Cooling 10%, Industrial 30%, Transport 10%
- Repair deadline: 30 days for all types
- Follow-up verification: 10 days (vs 30 days under Section 608)
- Record retention: Minimum 3 years

## Glossary

- **A2L Refrigerant**: ASHRAE 34 safety classification for mildly flammable refrigerants. Examples: R-454B, R-32, R-452B.
- **AIM Act**: American Innovation and Manufacturing Act of 2020, authorizing EPA to phase down HFC production and establish Subpart C leak repair requirements.
- **Annualized Leak Rate (Method 1)**: (Refrigerant Added / Full Charge) x (365 / Days Since Last Charge) x 100. EPA standard for threshold determinations.
- **Chronic Leaker**: Equipment where calendar-year refrigerant additions exceed 125% of full charge. Report to EPA by March 1 under Subpart C.
- **CRM (Customer Relationship Management)**: Software for tracking clients, jobs, communications, and service history. FieldPad is a CRM purpose-built for solo HVAC service businesses.
- **EPA Section 608**: Clean Air Act section governing ODS refrigerant handling in stationary HVAC/refrigeration equipment.
- **Full Charge**: Total refrigerant required for a system to operate at designed capacity.
- **GWP (Global Warming Potential)**: Heat-trapping measure relative to CO2. GWP > 53 triggers Subpart C; GWP <= 53 exempt.
- **HFC (Hydrofluorocarbon)**: Synthetic refrigerants replacing ODS. High GWP. Subject to AIM Act phase-down. Examples: R-410A, R-407C, R-134a.
- **Leak Rate Threshold**: Maximum allowable annualized leak rate before mandatory repair. Varies by appliance type and regulatory framework.
- **Method 2 (Screening)**: (Refrigerant Added / Full Charge) x 100. Shows actual charge loss without annualizing.
- **ODS (Ozone-Depleting Substance)**: Refrigerants that deplete stratospheric ozone. Subject to Section 608. Examples: R-22, R-12.
- **Subpart C**: 40 CFR Part 84, Subpart C. HFC leak repair requirements for systems with 15+ lbs, GWP > 53. Effective January 1, 2026.
- **Verification Test**: Post-repair leak test. Initial at completion; follow-up within 30 days (Section 608) or 10 days (Subpart C).
- **5,000 Rule**: If (refrigerant cost/lb x full charge) > $5,000, replacement may be more economical than repair.

## Disclaimer

FieldPad is a record-keeping and calculation tool. It is not a substitute for professional legal, regulatory, or compliance advice. Users are solely responsible for the accuracy of data entered and for meeting EPA compliance obligations.
